    <div class="editorial-intro">
      <p>
        Color is one of the clearest visual signatures of automotive design.
      </p>
      <p>
        Across decades of production, manufacturers offered bold greens, deep blues, rich golds, and earthy browns. But looking at modern roads, the palette appears radically concentrated.
      </p>

    <!-- THE QUESTION: DIVERSITY METRIC -->
    <div class="diversity-investigation">
      <div class="investigation-badge">THE QUESTION</div>
      <p class="diversity-lead">
        Over time, some colors became far more common while others nearly vanished from production lines.
      </p>
      <p class="diversity-lead">
        But does that mean cars actually became less colorful?
      </p>
      <div class="diversity-answer-bridge">
        <span>That depends on how we define and measure diversity.</span>
      </div>

      <div class="metric-explainer-card">
        <div class="metric-header">
          <span class="metric-tag">STATISTICAL MEASURE</span>
          <h4 class="metric-name">COLOR DIVERSITY &bull; EFFECTIVE NUMBER OF COLORS</h4>
        </div>
        <div class="metric-formula-explanation">
          <p>
            If one color dominates the entire market, diversity is minimal. If many colors share the market evenly, diversity is high.
          </p>
          <p class="metric-plain-english">
            Statisticians quantify market variety using the Inverse Simpson Index ($D = \frac{1}{\sum p_i^2}$, where $p_i$ is each color\x27s market share proportion). This calculates the <em>effective number of equal-sized colors</em> that would yield the exact same level of market concentration.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="metric-stats-grid">
          <div class="metric-stat-box">
            <div class="stat-era">1970 BASELINE</div>
            <div class="stat-number color-vibrant">7.9</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Effective Colors</div>
            <div class="stat-detail">Market spread widely across blue (18%), green (16%), brown/beige (14%), red (12%), and gold (9%). Greyscale accounted for only 28%.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="metric-stat-box">
            <div class="stat-era">1985 DIVERSITY PEAK</div>
            <div class="stat-number color-vibrant">8.6</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Effective Colors</div>
            <div class="stat-detail">The statistical peak of variety: red (16%), blue (15%), brown (12%), white (17%), and silver (9%) each commanded substantial volume.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="metric-stat-box">
            <div class="stat-era">2024 MODERN MARKET</div>
            <div class="stat-number color-muted">4.7</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Effective Colors</div>
            <div class="stat-detail">White (35%), black (22%), gray (17%), and silver (8%) capture 82% of all vehicles produced globally.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

,{"Year":2017,"White":35,"Black":20,"Gray":15,"Silver":10,"Blue":8,"Red":6,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2},{"Year":2018,"White":37,"Black":19,"Gray":16,"Silver":10,"Blue":7,"Red":5,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2},{"Year":2019,"White":37,"Black":19,"Gray":16,"Silver":10,"Blue":7,"Red":5,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2},{"Year":2020,"White":38,"Black":19,"Gray":15,"Silver":9,"Blue":7,"Red":5,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":3},{"Year":2021,"White":37,"Black":20,"Gray":16,"Silver":9,"Blue":8,"Red":4,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2},{"Year":2022,"White":36,"Black":21,"Gray":16,"Silver":9,"Blue":8,"Red":4,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2},{"Year":2023,"White":36,"Black":22,"Gray":16,"Silver":8,"Blue":8,"Red":4,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2},{"Year":2024,"White":35,"Black":22,"Gray":17,"Silver":8,"Blue":8,"Red":4,"Green":1,"Brown_Beige":2,"Yellow_Gold":1,"Other":2}];

const colorMeta = {
  White: { label: "White", short: "White", hex: "#f8fafc", textHex: "#0f172a", border: true },
  Black: { label: "Black", short: "Black", hex: "#18181b", textHex: "#f8fafc", border: false },
  Gray: { label: "Gray", short: "Gray", hex: "#64748b", textHex: "#ffffff", border: false },
  Silver: { label: "Silver", short: "Silver", hex: "#cbd5e1", textHex: "#0f172a", border: true },
  Blue: { label: "Blue", short: "Blue", hex: "#2563eb", textHex: "#ffffff", border: false },
  Red: { label: "Red", short: "Red", hex: "#dc2626", textHex: "#ffffff", border: false },
  Green: { label: "Green", short: "Green", hex: "#16a34a", textHex: "#ffffff", border: false },
  Brown_Beige: { label: "Brown / Beige", short: "Brown", hex: "#a16207", textHex: "#ffffff", border: false },
  Yellow_Gold: { label: "Gold / Yellow", short: "Gold", hex: "#eab308", textHex: "#0f172a", border: false },
  Other: { label: "Other", short: "Other", hex: "#7c3aed", textHex: "#ffffff", border: false }
};

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  renderLegend();
  renderTimelineStream();
});

function renderLegend() {
  const container = document.getElementById("color-legend");
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = Object.entries(colorMeta).map(([key, item]) => `
    <div class="legend-chip">
      <span class="legend-color-box" style="background-color: ${item.hex}; ${item.border ? "border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);" : ""}"></span>
      <span class="legend-color-label">${item.label}</span>
    </div>
  `).join("");
}

function renderTimelineStream() {
  const container = document.getElementById("timeline-stream-container");
  if (!container) return;

  container.innerHTML = colorData.map(d => {
    // Bar segments with inside percentage if >= 5%
    const segmentsHtml = Object.entries(colorMeta).map(([key, meta]) => {
      const pct = d[key] || 0;
      if (pct === 0) return "";
      if (pct >= 5) {
        return `<div class="bar-seg" style="width: ${pct}%; background-color: ${meta.hex}; color: ${meta.textHex};" title="${meta.label}: ${pct}% (${d.Year})">${pct}%</div>`;
      } else {
        return `<div class="bar-seg is-narrow" style="width: ${pct}%; background-color: ${meta.hex};" title="${meta.label}: ${pct}% (${d.Year})"></div>`;
      }
    }).join("");

    // Adjacent badges for small categories < 5%
    const smallBadgesHtml = Object.entries(colorMeta)
      .filter(([key]) => (d[key] || 0) > 0 && (d[key] || 0) < 5)
      .map(([key, meta]) => `<span class="micro-badge" title="${meta.label}: ${d[key]}%"><span class="badge-dot" style="background-color: ${meta.hex};"></span>${meta.short} ${d[key]}%</span>`)
      .join("");

    const isDecadeStart = d.Year % 10 === 0;

    return `
      <div class="timeline-row ${isDecadeStart ? "decade-start" : ""}" data-year="${d.Year}" onmouseenter="showReadout(${d.Year})" onclick="showReadout(${d.Year})">
        <div class="row-year-col">
          <span class="row-year-label">${d.Year}</span>
          ${isDecadeStart ? `<span class="decade-pill">${d.Year}s</span>` : ""}
        </div>
        <div class="row-bar-wrap">
          <div class="row-stacked-bar">${segmentsHtml}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="row-small-labels">
          ${smallBadgesHtml}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join("");
}

function showReadout(year) {
  const d = colorData.find(item => item.Year === year);
  const readout = document.getElementById("active-readout");
  if (!d || !readout) return;

  const greyscale = d.White + d.Black + d.Gray + d.Silver;
  const chromatic = 100 - greyscale;

  const breakdownChips = Object.entries(colorMeta)
    .filter(([key]) => (d[key] || 0) > 0)
    .map(([key, meta]) => `<span class="readout-chip" style="color: ${meta.hex === "#f8fafc" ? "#ffffff" : meta.hex};">${meta.short} <strong>${d[key]}%</strong></span>`)
    .join(" &bull; ");

  readout.innerHTML = `
    <div class="readout-active-content">
      <span class="readout-year">${d.Year} RECORD:</span>
      <span class="readout-chips">${breakdownChips}</span>
      <span class="readout-summary">[Greyscale: ${greyscale}% | Chromatic: ${chromatic}%]</span>
    </div>
  `;

  // Highlight active row
  document.querySelectorAll(".timeline-row").forEach(el => {
    if (el.getAttribute("data-year") === String(year)) {
      el.classList.add("is-selected-row");
    } else {
      el.classList.remove("is-selected-row");
    }
  });
}
</script>
